the single GENTER (0x00201420) receive site in SPTM, inside FUN_000ab8ac (sptm_genter_receive). Arms EL2 exception vectors then executes GENTER; x0=arg block, x1=SP. x16 selector decoded per SPTM_LOAD_DISPATCH_ID (domain bits 48-55, table 32-39, endpoint 0-31) for client dispatch GENTERs.
